entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to continue.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF88-91K2. Just get me the return label.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you. VF88-91K2... I see the Aero-Dynamic Pro Jersey. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I guess. The jersey is the wrong size. It's way too tight and I need to swap it.

I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Since it's an apparel item and I can see it was delivered just three days ago, you're well within our 90-day return policy. We can definitely process an exchange for you.
Great. So how do I do it?

I am generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email on your account. Once we receive the original jersey, we can ship out the new size. Which size would you like for the exchange?
A large. The one I got was a medium.

Perfect. I've noted that in your file. Your return label is on its way, and we'll get that size large jersey sent out as soon as the original is processed at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
